title: The Debt of Marseille's old port
author: Hazel Galloway
blurb: Gideon Ishikawa, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must burn the network that did the training before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
